subject: fmath
source: Cambridge IGCSE Additional Mathematics 0606 syllabus 2025–2027, Cambridge International

weeks.topic: Trigonometric functions of any angle; sec, cosec and cot
objectives: Define sin, cos, tan for any angle
Use sec, cosec and cot and exact values

weeks.topic: Graphs of trigonometric functions: amplitude, period and transformations
objectives: Sketch y = a sin(bx) + c and similar graphs
Identify amplitude and period

weeks.topic: Modulus of trigonometric graphs and graphical solutions
objectives: Sketch y = |a sin(bx)| and related graphs
Use graphs to find numbers of solutions

weeks.topic: Trigonometric identities: sin²x + cos²x = 1 and sec²x = 1 + tan²x
objectives: Use the Pythagorean identities
Use tan x = sin x / cos x

weeks.topic: Solving trigonometric equations in degrees and radians
objectives: Solve equations in a given interval
Use identities to form quadratic trigonometric equations

weeks.topic: Proving trigonometric identities
objectives: Prove identities by manipulating one side
Present clear chains of reasoning

weeks.topic: Differentiation: derivative of xⁿ and gradients of curves
objectives: Differentiate powers of x including negative and fractional
Find gradients at given points

weeks.topic: Differentiation: chain, product and quotient rules
objectives: Differentiate composite functions with the chain rule
Use product and quotient rules

weeks.topic: Derivatives of eˣ, ln x and trigonometric functions
objectives: Differentiate eˣ, ln x, sin x, cos x and tan x
Combine with the chain, product and quotient rules

weeks.topic: Tangents and normals to curves
objectives: Find equations of tangents and normals
Solve problems involving tangents meeting axes

weeks.topic: Stationary points and the second derivative
objectives: Find stationary points
Classify maxima and minima using the second derivative

weeks.topic: Connected rates of change
objectives: Use the chain rule for related rates
Solve problems with changing area or volume

weeks.topic: Small increments and approximations
objectives: Use δy ≈ (dy/dx)δx
Estimate small changes in a quantity

weeks.topic: Integration as the reverse of differentiation
objectives: Find indefinite integrals of powers of x
Find the equation of a curve from its gradient

weeks.topic: Term 1 review: trigonometry and differentiation
objectives: Consolidate trigonometric equations and identities
Practise differentiation questions

weeks.topic: Integrating eˣ, 1/(ax + b) and trigonometric functions
objectives: Integrate e^(ax+b), (ax+b)ⁿ and 1/(ax+b)
Integrate sin(ax+b) and cos(ax+b)

weeks.topic: Definite integrals
objectives: Evaluate definite integrals
Use exact values with ln and e

weeks.topic: Areas under curves and between a line and a curve
objectives: Find areas bounded by curves and the x-axis
Find areas between a line and a curve

weeks.topic: Kinematics: displacement, velocity and acceleration by differentiation
objectives: Differentiate displacement to find velocity and acceleration
Find when a particle is at rest

weeks.topic: Kinematics: using integration and total distance travelled
objectives: Integrate acceleration and velocity
Distinguish displacement from total distance travelled

weeks.topic: Practical maximisation and minimisation problems
objectives: Form an expression to optimise from a context
Use differentiation to find and justify optimum values

weeks.topic: Roots of quadratic equations: α and β, sum and product
objectives: Use α + β = −b/a and αβ = c/a
Form new equations with roots related to α and β

weeks.topic: Binomial expansion: products of expansions and approximations
objectives: Find coefficients in products such as (1 + x)(2 − x)⁵
Use expansions for approximations

weeks.topic: Mixed problem solving: functions, logarithms and calculus
objectives: Combine topics in multi-step questions
Select efficient methods

weeks.topic: Mixed problem solving: trigonometry, vectors, series and combinatorics
objectives: Solve unfamiliar multi-part questions
Link topics across the syllabus

weeks.topic: Exam technique: show-that questions, exact answers and accuracy
objectives: Present complete reasoning for show-that questions
Give exact or 3 s.f. answers as required

weeks.topic: Mock exams: Paper 1 and Paper 2
objectives: Sit both papers under exam conditions
Analyse results to plan revision

weeks.topic: Revision: functions, quadratics, modulus and inequalities
objectives: Revise composite and inverse functions
Practise discriminant and inequality questions

weeks.topic: Revision: polynomials, simultaneous equations, surds and logarithms
objectives: Revise factor and remainder theorems
Practise log and exponential equations

weeks.topic: Revision: straight-line graphs, coordinate geometry and circles
objectives: Revise linear form transformations
Practise circle equations and tangents

weeks.topic: Revision: circular measure and trigonometry
objectives: Revise radians, arcs and sectors
Practise trigonometric equations and identities

weeks.topic: Revision: permutations, combinations, series and vectors
objectives: Revise counting methods and binomial expansion
Practise progressions and vector problems

weeks.topic: Revision: differentiation, integration and kinematics
objectives: Revise all differentiation rules
Practise area and kinematics questions

weeks.topic: Final exams: Additional Mathematics Paper 1
objectives: Sit Paper 1 with full working
Manage time across all questions

weeks.topic: Final exams: Additional Mathematics Paper 2
objectives: Sit Paper 2 with full working
Check exact answers and accuracy

weeks.topic: Exam season: targeted practice on weakest topics
objectives: Review errors from papers already taken
Practise short calculus and algebra sets

weeks.topic: Exam season close: reflection and bridge to IB Mathematics AA
objectives: Reflect on the course
Preview proof and calculus extensions in IB AA
